<!-- pr-reviewer: c0b4dfc856a775573ccc41c14a63ee5dbf5a0b36 -->
Needs changes before merge. One test is weak. The rest is good.

What looks good
- The toggle is ephemeral view state: the field `show_work_envelope` in `State`, off by default, never saved, no command. This fits "Everything Is a Command": the law excludes ephemeral view state, like the world-origin axes box. A test shows no pending command, no history entry and an unchanged machine.
- The ui layer makes no flecs call. It uses `camcraft_app::machine::work_envelope`.
- No `Cargo.toml` change, so no new `camcraft-*` dependency.
- Bad travel does not panic. A missing axis, a missing travel, a non-finite value and an inverted range each return `Err` with the name. A lathe with zero reach returns `Err`.
- All new files are under 400 lines. No snapshot PNG changed. No posting code changed.
- The decision file is present. Provenance lines are present.

Results (locally, merged with main; the trial merge had one conflict, a module list in `crates/post/src/machine/mod.rs`, resolved by keeping both lines)
- `cargo test -p camcraft-post --lib envelope`: 4 passed.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib work_envelope` (CWD `crates/ui`): 3 passed.
- `cargo clippy -D warnings --all-targets` on post, app and ui: clean.

Mutation check
- I changed `origin[k] + b * ax.direction.sign()` to `origin[k] + b` in `envelope()`. All 4 tests still passed.

Requested before merge
1. `crates/post/src/machine/envelope.rs`, test `an_inverted_axis_flips_about_the_origin`: the Z travel is `-30..0`, so the upper bound is 0 and the sign has no effect. Use a travel with a non-zero upper end on the inverted axis (for example `-30..10`) and a non-zero origin. Assert the full `min` and `max`.

Notes (not blocking)
- `envelope()` does not check that `origin` is finite. A NaN origin would give NaN overlay lines. Please check `origin` or the lines.
- The UI tests check one mill. There is no UI test for the lathe cylinder; only the shape maths is tested.

Not exercised: the GUI, the rendered look of the outline, the full quick gate suites (only the touched tests and clippy), and Windows-only arms (the diff has none).

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 7fa2018170f07b5e70f2341a8706f66ddb43ee55 -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge.** This is a delta review of c0b4dfc8..7fa20181.

What changed since the last review
- The merge of origin/main kept both module lines in `crates/post/src/machine/mod.rs`. Both `edm_taper` and `envelope` are in the list.
- The new test `an_inverted_axis_with_two_nonzero_ends_flips_both_bounds` is in `crates/post/src/machine/envelope.rs`. It uses an X travel of -100..200 and origin 10, and expects (-190, 110).

The earlier blocker is answered
- I removed the direction sign from the upper bound (`origin[k] + b`). The new test fails with left (110.0, 210.0) and right (-190.0, 110.0). I reverted the change.

Results (locally, merged with main, own worktree)
- `cargo test -p camcraft-post machine::envelope`: 5 passed, 0 failed.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib work_envelope` (CWD `crates/ui`): 3 passed, 0 failed.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-post -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.

Requested before merge
- None.

Notes (not blocking)
- I did not run the full suites of the other PRs merged from main. They are outside this delta.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
